analysis: The changes are CI and test-lane only; no runtime or coordinator code is in this batch. integration.yml (patch hunks near lines 304-340) changes the default-posture smoke lane. It now expects DARKBLOOM_TESTBED_EXPECT_KV_BACKEND=paged instead of contiguous. It also adds a guard that fails if DARKBLOOM_CBV2_KV_QUANTIZATION is set, so the lane measures the provider's own precision default. This only shifts a test expectation; it suggests the provider's .auto default moved to balanced paged, but that change is not in this batch. If the provider default change ships separately, it may touch the T-041 surface (prefix cache and SSD tier, TB-007). The next pass should check that no change alters the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate, the TTL, or the cacheSalt plumbing. ci.yml (head text only, no diff shown; 076a7f31c830ce1b:4 and :5) uses the pull_request trigger, not pull_request_target. Actions are pinned by SHA. Secrets are not exposed to the test steps. The coordinator tests use a local throwaway Postgres. Artifact uploads cover only timings, coverage and diagnostics. Nothing visible touches the TB-001 to TB-011 boundaries, attestation, App Attest authorization, billing or encryption. Coverage limit: the exact ci.yml diff was not supplied, so only the head text was reviewed. Nothing indicates a security regression.
